notes:
Summary: Mid-market support platform focusing on enterprise SMBs. Primary ask = high-quality ticket/email summarization + rule-based and ML auto-tagging to power macros and workflow triggers in Zendesk/Freshdesk. Wants reliable 95th-pct latency under 250ms for short summaries, ripple resilience during Black Friday-like spikes.

Key contacts: CTO - Lena Morris, Head of Product - Ravi Shah (very pragmatic on ROI), Dir. Ops - Maia Chen (owns Zendesk).

What we heard on call (02/18 FF):
- "We get 150k inbound emails/month, peaks 12k/day during promos"
- "Auto-tags must be > 85% precision on priority/bug labels or ops will not trust it"
- "Need audit trail for every generated macro - who triggered it, what prompt used"

Technical requirements / red flags:
- Primary stack: Zendesk + Freshdesk pilot instances, Snowflake for analytics, internal SSO via Okta.
- Data residency: EU + US zones required, want option to keep customer PII out of hosted logs.
- Must support Zendesk apps (server-side) and Freshdesk webhook flows; prefer server-side plugin approach, not client-injected scripts.
- Spike handling: require documented degradation policy (e.g., short summaries, sampling, fallback model in lower-cost tier).

POC scope proposed:
- 2-week sandbox integrated with Zendesk sandbox for 3 agents.
- Acceptance criteria: summary quality >= 4.3/5 on internal judge set, auto-tag precision >= 85% for 6 top tags, end-to-end latency P95 <= 350ms (aim 250ms).
- Load test: synthetic burst to 15k reqs/day over 48h to validate autoscaling/fallback.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Budget pre-approved internally ~100k ARR for 12 months if POC hits targets.
- Procurement wants data-residency addendum and SOC2 Appendix.

Quotes / call snippets: "If we can cut triage time by 30% and keep tagging accurate, this replaces two headcount FTEs in Ops."

Short-term next steps:
- Schedule POC kickoff (Aisha to align calendar).
- Send updated security FAQ + residency addendum draft (Marco).
- Maia to open Zendesk sandbox support ticket for app install (INF-2410).

Longer-term signals:
- Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput; will consider Private if residency/legal requires on-prem or VPC-only logs.
